# Section 1: Proportion of G/G in a population

Downloaded a CSV files from Ensemble < https://useast.ensembl.org/Homo_sapiens/Variation/Sample?db=core;r=17:39800098-39990099;v=rs8067378;vdb=variation;vf=959672880;sample=%20HG00109 > 

Here we read this CSV file

```{r}
mxl <- read.csv("373531-SampleGenotypes-Homo_sapiens_Variation_Sample_rs8067378.csv")

head(mxl)
```

```{r}
table(mxl$Genotype..forward.strand.)
```

```{r}
table(mxl$Genotype..forward.strand.)/ nrow(mxl) * 100
```

Now let's look at at different population. I picked the GBR.

```{r}
gbr <- read.csv("373522-SampleGenotypes-Homo_sapiens_Variation_Sample_rs8067378.csv")

head(gbr)
```

Find proportion of G|G

```{r}
round( table(gbr$Genotype..forward.strand.) / nrow(gbr) * 100, 2 )
```

This variant that is associated with childhood asthma is more frequent in the GBR population than the MKL population.

Let's now dig into this further.





```{r}
library(bio3d)

```
```{r}
aln <- read.fasta("muscle-I20251201-001146-0795-58502801-p1m.aln-clustalw(seaview)")
```

```{r}
id_matrix <- seqidentity(aln$ali) * 100
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

id_long <- melt(id_matrix)
colnames(id_long) <- c("Seq1", "Seq2", "Identity")
```

```{r}
ggplot(id_long, aes(x=Seq1, y=Seq2, fill=Identity)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="blue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))
```

```{r}
seq_id <- seqidentity(aln)
print(seq_id)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

seq_names <- rownames(aln$ali)
rownames(id_matrix) <- seq_names
colnames(id_matrix) <- seq_names

pheatmap(seq_id,
         labels_row = c("Channel catfish", "Human_BB", "Black bullhead", "Bony fishes1", "Ray-finned fishes1", "Ray-finned fishes2", "Bony fishes2", "North African catfish"),
         labels_col = c("Channel catfish", "Human_BB", "Black bullhead", "Bony fishes1", "Ray-finned fishes1", "Ray-finned fishes2", "Bony fishes2", "North African catfish"),
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
         clustering_method = "complete",
         display_numbers = FALSE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("yellow","orange","red"))(100),
         fontsize_row = 10,
         fontsize_col = 10,
         main = "Sequence Identity Heatmap")
```







```{r}
consensus_seq <- consensus(aln)
```


```{r}
library(bio3d)

class(aln)

seq_id <- seqidentity(aln$ali)  
diag(seq_id) <- NA            
avg_identity <- rowMeans(seq_id, na.rm = TRUE)

best_seq_index <- which.max(avg_identity)

query_seq <- aln$ali[best_seq_index, ]             
query_seq_string <- paste(query_seq, collapse="")  


query_seq_string <- gsub("-", "", query_seq_string)
blast_results <- blast.pdb(query_seq_string)

str(blast_results)
```

```{r}
# Use the hits data frame
hits_df <- blast_results$hits

# Keep only the first occurrence of each unique PDB ID
unique_hits <- hits_df[!duplicated(hits_df$pdb.id), ]

# Sort by E-value (smallest first)
top_hits <- unique_hits[order(unique_hits$e.value), ][1:3, ]
```

```{r}
str(unique_hits$e.value)
```

```{r}
library(bio3d)

b <- read.fasta("seqdump.txt")

# Suppose seq_id is your sequence identity matrix
avg_identity <- rowMeans(seq_id)        # average identity for each sequence
best_seq_index <- which.max(avg_identity)  # sequence most similar to all others

# Extract sequence and remove gaps
query_seq <- b[[best_seq_index]]$seq
query_seq_string <- paste(query_seq, collapse = "")
query_seq_string <- gsub("-", "", query_seq_string)

# Check sequence
substr(query_seq_string, 1, 60)

```

```{r}
str(seq_id)
seq_id[is.na(seq_id)] <- 0  # or use another appropriate value
str(seq_id)
```

```{r}
avg_identity <- rowMeans(seq_id, na.rm = TRUE)
avg_identity

best_seq_index <- which.max(avg_identity)
best_seq_index

# alignment is a list of sequences
# Check length
length(b)

# Extract the best sequence
query_seq <- b[[best_seq_index]]$seq
query_seq_string <- paste(query_seq, collapse = "")
query_seq_string <- gsub("-", "", query_seq_string)

# View first 60 residues
substr(query_seq_string, 1, 60)


```

```{r}
best_seq_index <- which.max(avg_identity)

# Check the index
best_seq_index

if(length(best_seq_index) == 1 && best_seq_index <= length(b)) {
  query_seq <- b[[best_seq_index]]$seq
  query_seq_string <- paste(query_seq, collapse = "")
  query_seq_string <- gsub("-", "", query_seq_string)
} else {
  stop("Error: best_seq_index is invalid. Check your seq_id matrix and alignment.")
}

substr(query_seq_string, 1, 60)  # view first 60 residues


```


```{r}
library(bio3d)

alignment <- read.fasta("seqdump.txt")
n_seq <- length(alignment)
if(n_seq < 1) stop("No sequences found in the alignment.")

# Convert alignment to a matrix of characters
seq_matrix <- t(sapply(alignment, function(x) {
  if(is.list(x)) x$seq else x
}))

seq_matrix <- t(sapply(alignment, function(x) {
  seq_vec <- if(is.list(x)) x$seq else x
  if(length(seq_vec) != seq_lengths[1]) {
    stop("All sequences must be the same length for seqidentity()")
  }
  seq_vec
}))

seq_id <- seqidentity(seq_matrix)

avg_identity <- rowMeans(seq_id, na.rm = TRUE)
best_seq_index <- which.max(avg_identity)

# Safety check
if(length(best_seq_index) != 1 || best_seq_index > n_seq) {
  stop("Invalid best_seq_index. Check seq_id matrix and alignment.")
}

# Extract sequence
query_seq <- if(is.list(alignment[[best_seq_index]])) {
  alignment[[best_seq_index]]$seq
} else {
  alignment[[best_seq_index]]
}

# Convert to string and remove gaps
query_seq_string <- paste(query_seq, collapse = "")
query_seq_string <- gsub("-", "", query_seq_string)

cat("Representative sequence (first 60 residues):\n")
cat(substr(query_seq_string, 1, 60), "\n")
cat("Sequence length:", nchar(query_seq_string), "\n")



```
